subject: Aim for the Sky!
author: ZombieTron
body:
What I love about Showtime is there is no Gold target to reach. The crash is only limited by your ability.

Aim to beat your personal best. Aim to beat the Showtime Road Rule. Aim to beat your friends score. Aim to hit those buses and street signs. Aim for the Sky!

The same goes for Stunt Run, its not about achieving the target, but how far above the target you can go!

😃

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: I agree with you for the
author: blash
body: I agree with you for the most part. However, you can set a go-to point on the map, you just hit the start button and the LB button to go to the map, select the event you are aiming for, and then go back to the game. The event you want (generally a burning route for me) will be an itchy tiny icon off one of the edges of the map in the direction you want to drive to get there.
